display.purpose: The name lockup, ASHIRVAD / SATAPATHY, desktop only.

title.purpose: The founder line, in Graphite Note.

body.purpose: Rows, FAQ answers, and footer links.

label.purpose: Header place and time, availability, captions, and the uppercase footer.

motion.name: chevron
motion.purpose: FAQ chevron rotates 180 degrees when the row opens.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Skewed tick plus dEvAshirvad, sitting in the fixed header.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: hsl(0 0% 98%); background: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-wordmark-tick { width: 4px; height: 16px; background: hsl(0 0% 98%); transform: skewX(-25deg); }

components.name: Availability
components.description: Signal Green dot and the available-for-work status. The only chromatic chrome.
components.css: .ds-availability { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: hsl(0 0% 98%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-availability-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4ade80; }

components.name: Ruled row
components.description: Featured-work index row. Title left, year right, solid guide rule.
components.css: .ds-ruled-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; width: 100%; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 14.9%); background: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; } .ds-ruled-row:hover { color: hsl(0 0% 63.9%); } .ds-ruled-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed hsl(0 0% 98%); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Dashed row
components.description: Contact, skill, and fact row. Label left, value right, dashed rule.
components.css: .ds-dashed-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed hsl(0 0% 14.9%); background: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dashed-row:hover { color: hsl(0 0% 63.9%); } .ds-dashed-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed hsl(0 0% 98%); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section index
components.description: Quiet slash index in an early column, headline in the late columns.
components.css: .ds-section { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 20px; background: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-section-index { grid-column: 2; color: hsl(0 0% 14.9%); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; } .ds-section-title { grid-column: 4 / span 2; margin: 0; color: hsl(0 0% 98%); font-size: 60px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Accordion trigger
components.description: FAQ row. Opens in place. Chevron rotates when open.
components.css: .ds-accordion { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 20px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(0 0% 14.9%); background: hsl(0 0% 3.9%); color: hsl(0 0% 98%); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-accordion-chevron { flex: none; color: hsl(0 0% 63.9%); transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-accordion:hover { color: hsl(0 0% 63.9%); } .ds-accordion:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed hsl(0 0% 98%); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-accordion[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-accordion-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

narrative.overview:
The Field Index is a survey sheet for a person: numbered columns, dashed guides, and one green status mark. The page is near-black, set entirely in JetBrains Mono, and read like a record. Display names sit large and offset. Secondary copy is graphite. The interface stays quiet so the work, when it appears, is the only saturated thing on the page.

Density is sparse. A five-column grid holds the desktop. Two dashed guides hold the phone. Section titles occupy the right columns. Indexes occupy a column to their left. Lists are full-width rules. Space above a block is larger than the space inside it.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, near-white ink, one green status dot
JetBrains Mono at every size, from 12px labels to 96px names
Five-column sheet on desktop, two dashed guides on small screens
Square corners, dashed or solid rules, no shadows
Client color lives only inside project images

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Client palettes stay inside the project image. The sheet around that image remains Field Black, Index White, Graphite Note, and Signal Green.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: Signal Green appears once, as the availability dot. It is not a link color, a heading color, or a fill behind type.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the only voice. Do not introduce a second family for display, labels, or numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not lift. Hover, focus, and open states change a rule or a type color. They do not add shadow, blur, or a second surface.

dos: Do keep new pages on Field Black, in JetBrains Mono, inside the five-column sheet.
Do put the index or return in an early column and the title in the late columns.
Do separate blocks with 5rem above the content and rules between items.
Do set secondary sentences in Graphite Note. Reserve Guide for lines and the existing homepage index.
Do show a project as a full-width plate, then its facts as dashed rows.
donts: Don't restyle the homepage to match a case study. The homepage is the source.
Don't bring client green, orange, cream, or gray out of the plate and into the chrome.
Don't use cards, pills, rounded shadcn buttons, or shadows on portfolio surfaces.
Don't promote Urbanist or add a second typeface.
Don't use Signal Green for anything except the availability dot.
Don't set readable copy in Guide. It disappears on Field Black.
